notes: `אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם` is read with fronting under rule 29: the article on the anarthrously rendered rectum takes the phrase's one *the*, while `מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ`, whose rectum is arthrous, gives the article the *the* before its own word and the construct a supplied one.

The three prepositional predicates (`בִּיהוּדָה`, `בָכֶם`, `עִמּוֹ`) each take the construction-supplied copula under rule 49, with the presentative dummy of the second joining that unit under rule 20.
The three datives (`לִי`, `עָלַי`, `לוֹ`) are each `unrepresented` under rule 40, their suffixes taking the bare English pronouns the ASV writes.
